# 0.1.6 — generate YAML dates and interactive setup

15 September 2026. Patch on the public **0.1.5** beta.

## Install

```bash
pip install opentide==0.1.6
export OPENTIDE_REPO_ROOT=/path/to/detection-repo
opentide validate --strict
```

## Fixed

- Unquoted `YYYY-MM-DD` values in `metadata.created` / `modified` no longer crash `opentide generate` with `TypeError: Object of type date is not JSON serializable` ([#178](https://github.com/opentidehq/opentide/issues/178)).
- Interactive `opentide setup` no longer raises `ValueError: validate must be callable` on the CI workflow features checkbox ([#177](https://github.com/opentidehq/opentide/issues/177)).

## Verify

```bash
python -c "import opentide; print(opentide.__version__)"
opentide generate
opentide validate --strict
```

Expect `0.1.6`.
